title: Choose the report's structure (safer hand, desktop)
question: Same Site Drawing Set look, conventional report layouts, sketched at desktop width. Each card says how it folds onto a phone.

options.label: Rooms and evidence, side by side
options.lineage: the master-detail layout of mail and file apps
options.thesis: A ranked list of rooms on the left, the selected room's evidence on the right, under one answer line; the plan and 3D sit above the list as its map.
materials: room list ruled like a schedule
options.viewport: Answer line '9 of 12 windows verified' across the top with the tally; left column the plan then five room rows; right the selected room (Bedroom 2) with its frame, counts, stamp and the letter and BOQ quotes in a margin. Phone: list, then the room opens full screen.
options.risk: Familiar to the point of plain; it relies on the evidence plate to carry the character.

raised.raise: One number at monumental scale: the verified count is the largest mark on the screen.
The letter and BOQ quotes hang in the evidence panel's margin, beside what they prove.
The room list ranks by weight and rules only, never by size, so the open rooms read first without shouting.
The outcome stamp sits half off the evidence plate, and registration ticks mark the plate's corners.
Rooms carry index numbers (R1 to R5) that match the plan and the room tags.
The Windows / Doors switch re-renders the whole sheet in place, list and evidence together.

options.label: The room walk
options.lineage: a site inspection report, one section per room
options.thesis: A summary block, then each room as its own section in walking order: plan tile, frames, verdict and sources, so the report reads top to bottom like an inspection.
options.viewport: Summary across the top (9 of 12, tally, what's open); a sticky index of rooms down the left; the main column shows Living Room's section with its three framed windows and the start of the Kitchen section below. Phone: one column, index becomes a chip row.
options.risk: Long on a phone; the open items must be reachable from the summary in one tap.

options.label: Summary and room table
options.lineage: a classic report: totals, then a schedule
options.thesis: Totals on top, then a ruled schedule with one row per room (planned, counted, coverage, outcome); a row opens in place to show its frames and sources.
materials: outcome stamps in the last column
options.viewport: Totals strip (Claimed 12 · Verified 9 · Short 2 · Not seen yet 1); a five-row schedule with Bedroom 2 open beneath its row showing its frame and quotes; plan and 3D on a tab beside the table. Phone: rows become stacked cards of the same fields.
options.risk: Banks will love it; it's the plainest of the three and the least like the landing page.

options.label: Airport signage
options.thesis: The report as overhead yellow sign bands.
options.viewport: Yellow bands naming each room's verdict.
options.case: Declined in the safer hand: replaces the drawing-set palette.

options.label: Centre-rail reference
options.thesis: Twin columns around a rail of keys.
options.viewport: A small text block in a wide annotated margin.
options.case: Declined: dense reference setting slows a buyer on a phone.
options.kept: Quotes hang in the margin beside what they prove.

options.label: Timetable slide rack
options.thesis: Everything at one type size on tinted glass.
options.case: Declined: glass and one-size type fight the drawing set.
options.kept: Rank by weight and rules, not size.

options.label: Design annual plates
options.thesis: Evidence as plates with crosshairs and stamps.
options.viewport: Frames as plates on near-white stock.
options.case: Declined in the safer hand, but closest: its stamp-on-plate already fits the drawing set.
options.kept: The stamp half off the evidence plate, ticks at the corners.

options.label: Event catalogue grid
options.viewport: A hall grid of tiny squares.
options.case: Declined: too dense for a payment decision.
options.kept: Numbered room index matching the tags.

options.label: Type specimen
options.thesis: A slider morphs the whole grid.
options.viewport: A grid of glyphs under a slider.
options.case: Declined: nothing in a report should morph continuously.
options.kept: One switch re-renders the whole sheet in place.
